issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error scenarios or edge cases, focusing mainly on the happy path.

scenarios.name: algolia-mdx-highlight
scenarios.rationale: Response B correctly uses environment variables for Algolia and defines the Highlight component, while Response A does not; both lack the required Tabs MDX page, but B covers more rubric items.

scenarios.name: versioned-docs-dropdown
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required commands and config snippet but the sidebar items are incorrect; Response B has the correct sidebar structure but omits the versioning commands.

scenarios.name: custom-page-deploy-github
scenarios.rationale: Both responses provide a page with a table and a config snippet, but neither uses the exact required organizationName and projectName or the exact deploy command; A is slightly closer to the rubric by using a simpler built‑in Table component and a deploy command that only differs in the placeholder name.
